entries.jp: 夜明けのように輝く\n五つの魂は　早速\n翌日から　行動に移した
entries.en:
The five souls,
shining like the
dawn, took action
the very next day.

entries.jp: みんな　集まってくれー！\nわしらが歌うぜよー！
entries.en:
Everybody,
gather round!
We're gonna
sing for ya!

entries.jp: 龍馬達の突風雷舞を\n告げる声と音色に\n人々が集まってくる
entries.en:
Drawn by the
voices and sounds
announcing
Ryoma's band's
guerrilla live,
people began to
gather.

entries.jp: お尋ね者だっていうのに\nこんなに派手にやるんだね
entries.en: You're wanted\nmen, and you still\ngo this big, huh?

entries.jp: ロックはこそこそ隠れて\n演奏するもんじゃない
entries.en:
Rock ain't
somethin' you
play sneakin'
around in hiding.

entries.jp: やるなら\nどーーーん　と\n派手にやらなくちゃ！
entries.en:
If you're gonna
do it, ya gotta
go BOOOOM
and make it big!

entries.jp: 今日は五人の初雷舞だから\n特に派手に行かないとね
entries.en:
Today's our first
live as a group
of five, so we
have to go
especially big.

entries.jp: 捕まることは\n考えてないの？
entries.en: Aren't you\nworried about\ngetting caught?

entries.jp: 捕まりそうになったら\n逃げりゃいいだけぜよ！
entries.en:
If they're
about to catch
us, we just run
for it, I tell ya!

entries.jp: さすがトサカくん
entries.en: That's Tosaka-kun\nfor you

entries.jp: 呆れた
entries.en: Unbelievable

entries.jp: 幕府を甘く見ない方がいい
entries.en: Don't\nunderestimate\nthe shogunate

entries.jp: さすがトサカくん
entries.en: That's Tosaka-kun\nfor you.

entries.jp: おお　ソウちんに\n褒められたぜよ～
entries.en: Whoa, So-chin\njust praised\nme, I tell ya~!

entries.jp: ほんとにおめでたい\n頭なんだね～\n僕は呆れてるんだけど
entries.en:
What a truly
happy-go-lucky
head you've
got~ I'm actually
appalled.

entries.jp: わしは歌いたいんじゃ！
entries.en: I wanna sing!

entries.jp: 誰もが　好きな歌を\n歌える世の中にしたい！
entries.en:
I wanna make
a world where
anyone can
sing the songs
they love!

entries.jp: そのためにも　まずは\nわしがみんなのために\n思いっきり歌うぜよ！
entries.en:
And for that,
first I'm gonna
sing my heart out
for everybody, I
tell ya!

entries.jp: その気持ちはわかるかな
entries.en: I guess I\nunderstand\nthat feeling.

entries.jp: 呆れた……\nだけどそれでこそ\nトサカくんなのかもね
entries.en:
Unbelievable...
But maybe
that's exactly
what makes you
Tosaka-kun.

entries.jp: 考えなしって言うか\n真っ直ぐすぎって\n言うか……バカ？
entries.en:
Reckless,
or just too
straightforward...
or an idiot?

entries.jp: お　おお　バカだとは\nしょっちゅう言われてるな
entries.en: W-well, I do get\ncalled an idiot\nall the time.

entries.jp: それでいいんじゃ！\nわしはロックバカぜよ！
entries.en:
And that's
just fine! I'm
a rock-crazy
idiot, I tell ya!

entries.jp: はい　はい\nでも　だからこそ\n輝いて見えるのかな
entries.en:
Yes, yes. But
maybe that's
exactly why you
seem to shine.

entries.jp: 幕府を甘く見ない方がいい\n井伊は何をしてくるか\nわからない奴だからね
entries.en:
You'd better not
underestimate
the shogunate.
There's no telling
what Ii might do.

entries.jp: 甘く見てるわけじゃないが\nしかし　わしらがやらんと\n何も始まらんだろ？
entries.en:
I ain't
underestimatin'
'em. But if
we don't do
it, nothin's
ever gonna
start, right?

entries.jp: やるしかないぜよ！
entries.en: We just\ngotta do it!

entries.jp: うん　そうだね
entries.en: Yeah,\nyou're right.

entries.jp: 最近は馴染みの客も\n増えて来たんだよ
entries.en:
We've been
getting more
regulars lately,
you know.

entries.jp: へぇ　観客も度胸あるんだ
entries.en: Huh, the\naudience has\nsome nerve too.

entries.jp: あのお武家さんなんて\nどう突き止めるのか\n毎回のようにいるぜよ
entries.en:
That samurai
over there,
f'rinstance. No
idea how he
tracks us down,
but he's there just
about every time.

entries.jp: どの人？
entries.en: Which one?

entries.jp: 端っこの方に立ってる\n編み笠をかぶったお人だ
entries.en:
The fella standin'
off at the edge,
wearin' the
woven straw hat.

entries.jp: あのさぁ　トサカくん\nメガネくんもだけど\n少しは怪しむべきだよ
entries.en:
Look, Tosaka-kun,
and you too,
Glasses-kun, you
should be a little
more suspicious.

entries.jp: ほえ？
entries.en: Huh?

entries.jp: 突風雷舞っていつどこで\nやるかって情報\n出ないんだよね
entries.en:
No one ever
finds out
when or where
your guerrilla
lives are going
to be, right?

entries.jp: そうですねぇ
entries.en: That's true...

entries.jp: なのに毎回のようにって\n普通　おかしいでしょ
entries.en:
And yet he's there
almost every
time? Normally,
that'd be weird.

entries.jp: 幕府の隠密だとか\n思わないわけ？
entries.en: Doesn't it occur to\nyou he might be a\nshogunate spy?

entries.jp: そりゃない　ない\nあの人は楽しそうに\nわしらの歌を聴いちょる
entries.en:
Nah, no way.
That fella listens
to our songs like
he's havin' a blast.

entries.jp: ロックが好きなヤツに\n悪いヤツはおらん
entries.en: Nobody who\nloves rock can\nbe a bad guy.

entries.jp: はぁぁぁぁっ\n本気で言ってるからな\nこの人
entries.en: Haaaah... He\nactually means\nthat, this guy.

entries.jp: それが龍馬くん\nですからねぇ
entries.en: That's just how\nRyoma-kun is.

entries.jp: こらそこ！　のんびり\n油売ってんじゃねえ！
entries.en: Hey, you guys!\nQuit slacking\noff over there!

entries.jp: 客が集まったようだ\nそろそろ始めるべき\nだろう
entries.en:
Looks like the
crowd's gathered.
We should start
soon.

entries.jp: こっちは準備万端だぜ
entries.en: We're all set\nover here.

entries.jp: わかったぜよ
entries.en: Gotcha!

entries.jp: 待たせたな！\n今から始まる\n俺達の雷舞！
entries.en: Sorry to keep ya\nwaitin'! Our live\nstarts right now!

entries.jp: 最高に盛り上がって\nいくぜよーーーっ
entries.en: Let's get this\nparty rockin' as\nhard as it goes!

entries.jp: 最後の片魂を　近藤が\n持っていたとは……
entries.en: To think Kondo\nheld the last\nPiece Soul...

entries.jp: 沖田の片魂も浄化され\n坂本達に合流――
entries.en:
And with Okita's
Piece Soul
purified as well,
he has joined
Sakamoto's band--

entries.jp: これで全ての片魂が\nひとつの所に揃ったことに\nなる
entries.en:
That means every
Piece Soul has
now gathered in
one place.

entries.jp: これも　あの男の\n筋書き通りか……
entries.en: Is this, too, going\nexactly as that\nman planned...?

entries.jp: だが　超魂が復活したとて\n我にとってはむしろ好都合
entries.en: Even if the Ultra\nSoul revives, it\nmerely serves me.

entries.jp: 集まったところを根こそぎ\n奪えば良いだけのこと\nいや　それよりも……
entries.en:
Once they've
gathered, I need
only take them
all in one sweep.
No, better still...

entries.jp: 超魂の復活こそが\nあやつらの命取りとなる\nフフフ……
entries.en:
...the revival of
the Ultra Soul will
be the very thing
that kills them.
Heh heh heh...

entries.jp: ああ　慶喜様\n今しばらくの\nご辛抱を
entries.en:
Ah,
Yoshinobu-sama,
please bear
with it just a
little longer.

entries.jp: 邪魔者は　全てこの直弼が\n排除して差し上げましょう
entries.en: I, Naosuke, shall\nremove every last\nobstacle for you.

entries.jp: 慶喜様は　ただ君臨し\nただ支配すればよいのです
entries.en:
You need
only reign,
Yoshinobu-sama.
Simply rule.

entries.jp: くくく……\nはははははははは
entries.en: Hehehe...\nHahahahahahaha!

entries.jp: 龍馬達の突風雷舞は\n連日に及んだ
entries.en:
Ryoma's band
kept up their
guerrilla lives
day after day.

entries.jp: 休憩で店に戻ってくると\nお登勢がいつものように\n笑顔で出迎える
entries.en:
When they
returned to the
inn for a break,
Otose greeted
them with her
usual smile.

entries.jp: お帰り　疲れただろう\n今おいしい物を作るからね
entries.en:
Welcome back,
dears. You must
be tired. I'll whip
up something
tasty right now.

entries.jp: お登勢やん　感謝するぜよ\nいっぱい歌って\nわしゃ　腹ぺこぜよ～
entries.en:
Otose-yan, you're
a lifesaver! All
that singin' left
me starvin'!

entries.jp: はいはい
entries.en: Yes, yes.

entries.jp: それにしても\n大丈夫なのかい？
entries.en: Still, are you sure\nyou'll be all right?

entries.jp: 龍ちゃん達\nお上に目をつけられてる\nそうじゃないか
entries.en:
I hear the
authorities have
their eye on
you, Ryo-chan.

entries.jp: 歌いたいって気持ちは\nわかるけれど　命あっての\n物種だからねぇ
entries.en:
I understand
wanting to
sing, dear, but
you can't sing
if you're dead,
you know.

entries.jp: 心配いらんぜよ\n仲間も増えたし\nきっとうまくやれる
entries.en:
No need to worry,
I tell ya! We got
more comrades
now. We'll pull it
off for sure.

entries.jp: それに　男には\nやらなくちゃならん時が\nあるぜよ
entries.en:
Besides, there are
times a man's just
gotta do what
he's gotta do.

entries.jp: 男の子なのねェ……
entries.en: Boys will be boys,\nwon't they...

entries.jp: おお　龍さん\n帰ってきたか
entries.en: Well, Ryo-san!\nYou're back!

entries.jp: 弥太郎！\nなんだか久々だな
entries.en: Yataro! Feels like\nit's been ages!

entries.jp: おう　帰って来たぜ
entries.en: Yep, I'm back!

entries.jp: 彦根にいた弥太郎は\nいつの間にか\n京に戻っていた
entries.en:
Yataro, who had
been in Hikone,
had at some
point come back
to Kyoto.

entries.jp: 弥太郎は元気そうだな
entries.en: You're lookin'\nwell, Yataro.

entries.jp: 妙な噂を聞いたんで\n皆に知らせようと\n急いで駆けつけたんじゃ
entries.en:
I heard a
strange rumor,
so I came runnin'
to tell you all!

entries.jp: 噂って……\nわしらのことか？
entries.en: A rumor...\nabout us?

entries.jp: 随分有名に\nなってきたからなぁ\nぐふふふ
entries.en:
We have been
gettin' pretty
famous, after
all. Heh heh heh.

entries.jp: ぶっぶー　ハズレ\n龍さん達のことでは\nないんじゃ
entries.en: Bzzzt! Wrong! It\nain't about you\nguys, Ryo-san.

entries.jp: なら　どんな噂だ？
entries.en: Then what\nkinda rumor?

entries.jp: モジャモジャの先生が\n今度雷舞をするらしい
entries.en:
Word is the
Shaggy Sensei's
gonna be doin'
a live soon.

entries.jp: な　なんだと……！
entries.en: Wh-what did\nyou say...!?

entries.jp: そ　それは\n松陰先生のことですか
entries.en: D-do you mean\nShoin-sensei?

entries.jp: そう　吉田松陰！\n龍さんが捜してた\n偉い先生じゃろ？
entries.en:
That's right,
Shoin Yoshida!
The big-shot
sensei you were
lookin' for,
Ryo-san, right?

entries.jp: そうだ！\nモジャモジャの先生は\n無事だったのか！
entries.en: Sure is! So\nthe Shaggy\nSensei's safe!

entries.jp: 生きて……生きていて\nくださった！　先生っ！
entries.en: He's alive... He's\nalive! Sensei!

entries.jp: オイ！　言え！\nどんな噂か\nさっさと言え！
entries.en: Hey! Talk! What's\nthe rumor!? Spit\nit out!

entries.jp: ぐへぇぇぇっ！\n言いたくても……首\n絞められたら……ぐええ
entries.en:
Gwaaagh! I'd
love to... but
you're... chokin'
me... gweeeh...

entries.jp: お　落ち着いて\n晋作
entries.en: C-calm down,\nShinsaku.

entries.jp: あ　ああ
entries.en: R-right.

entries.jp: うへぇ……死ぬかと思った\nひどいぜ　高杉さん\nせっかく教えに来たのに
entries.en:
Ugh... Thought
I was a goner!
That's harsh,
Takasugi-san!
I rush over
with hot news,
and this is the
thanks I get?

entries.jp: すまん\nほら　詫びてやったから　\nさっさと言え！
entries.en: Sorry. There,\nI apologized,\nso spit it out!

entries.jp: 有名な志士である\n吉田松陰が久しぶりに\n雷舞するらしいぜよ
entries.en:
Here's the scoop:
the famous rebel
Shoin Yoshida's
gonna hold a live,
first one in ages!

entries.jp: 場所と日付はわかってる\nそんだけじゃ
entries.en: I know the place\nand the date.\nThat's all I got.

entries.jp: 良かったなぁ\nシンディ　センセー！
entries.en: Ain't that great,\nShindy, Sensei!

entries.jp: 正直言って　松陰先生は\n幕府に拘束されていると\n思っていました
entries.en:
To be honest, I
thought
Shoin-sensei was
being held by
the shogunate.

entries.jp: もっと悪い状況も\n想像していたぜ\n消息不明が長かったからな
entries.en:
I imagined even
worse. He'd
been missing
for so long.

entries.jp: 謀殺される可能性も\n十分にあっただろう
entries.en: There was every\nchance he'd been\nassassinated.

entries.jp: 口に出せば真実になる\n気がして言えなかったし\n信じたくなかったからな
entries.en:
I couldn't say it
out loud. Felt like
saying it would
make it true, and
I didn't want to
believe it.

entries.jp: だが実際は違っていた\n生きていたんだ！\n良かった！
entries.en:
But that's not
how it turned
out. He's alive!
Thank goodness!

entries.jp: 殺すのは最終手段だよ\n井伊なら利用することを\n考えるに決まってるし
entries.en:
Killing is the last
resort. Ii is sure
to be thinking of
how to use him
instead.

entries.jp: 松陰先生が\n井伊ごときに\n利用されるかよ！
entries.en:
As if Shoin-sensei
would let a small
fry like Ii use
him!

entries.jp: 井伊を甘く見ると\n痛い目に遭うよ
entries.en: Underestimate\nIi and you'll\nget burned.

entries.jp: 実際　僕も痛い目に\n遭ったわけだし
entries.en: After all, I got\nburned myself.

entries.jp: 松陰先生は\nてめえらとは違うぜ
entries.en: Shoin-sensei isn't\nlike you people.

entries.jp: そうかな～
entries.en: Is that so~?

entries.jp: ちっ\n気に入らねえ野郎だ
entries.en: Tch. What an\nirritating punk.

entries.jp: だが……そうか……\n松陰先生の雷舞か！
entries.en: But... so that's\nit... A live by\nShoin-sensei!

entries.jp: 這いつくばってでも\n雷舞に行かねえとな！
entries.en:
I've gotta get
to that live,
even if I have
to crawl there!

entries.jp: ちょっと待って　晋作
entries.en: Wait a moment,\nShinsaku.

entries.jp: なんだ　桂さん
entries.en: What is it,\nKatsura-san?

entries.jp: 落ち着いて考えましょう\nこの話　怪しすぎると\n思いませんか？
entries.en:
Let's think this
through calmly.
Don't you find
this story far
too suspicious?

entries.jp: 桂さんは松陰先生に\n会いたくないのかよ
entries.en: Don't you want to\nsee Shoin-sensei,\nKatsura-san?

entries.jp: 会いたいですよ　私だって\nそれが本物の\n松陰先生ならね
entries.en:
Of course I
want to see him.
If it's the real
Shoin-sensei,
that is.

entries.jp: どういうことだ？
entries.en: What's that\nsupposed\nto mean?

entries.jp: これは罠だと\n言ってるんです
entries.en: I'm saying\nthis is a trap.

entries.jp: はああ？\nどうして罠だと\n断言できるんだ？
entries.en: Huuuh? How\ncan you be so\nsure it's a trap?

entries.jp: 私達が派手に動き出したら\n今まで消息不明だった松陰\n先生の噂が突然出てきた
entries.en:
The moment we
make big moves,
a rumor suddenly
surfaces about
Shoin-sensei,
missing all this
time.

entries.jp: こんなの　どう考えても\nおかしいでしょう
entries.en: Any way you\nlook at it,\nthat's strange.

entries.jp: 私達をおびき出すには\nあつらえ向きすぎですよ
entries.en: It's far too\nconvenient a way\nto lure us out.

entries.jp: 考えすぎだ
entries.en: You're\noverthinking it.

entries.jp: はーい　メガネくんに\n賛成～
entries.en: Okaaay, I'm with\nGlasses-kun~

entries.jp: 状況から見て\n罠の可能性が高いな
entries.en: Judging by the\nsituation, it's\nlikely a trap.

entries.jp: くっ\n龍馬は？
entries.en: Tch... What about\nyou, Ryoma?

entries.jp: わしはシンディに賛成だ\nモジャモジャの先生の歌を\n聴いてみたかったぜよ
entries.en:
I'm with Shindy.
I've been
wantin' to hear
the Shaggy
Sensei sing!

entries.jp: よーし！　なにがあろうと\nオレ様は雷舞に行くぜ
entries.en:
All right! No
matter what
happens, yours
truly is going
to that live!

entries.jp: わしもぜよ！
entries.en: Me too, I tell ya!

entries.jp: 興奮して血がたぎるぜ！
entries.en: I'm so pumped my\nblood's boiling!

entries.jp: 晋作……
entries.en: Shinsaku...

entries.jp: あのさぁ\n勝手に熱くなるのは\n構わないけど
entries.en:
Look, I don't
mind you
getting all fired
up on your own...

entries.jp: 君たちが捕まったら\n助けに行くのめんど\nくさいんですけどぉ～
entries.en:
...but if you get
caught, going to
rescue you would
be suuuch a pain~

entries.jp: その時は\n見捨ててもいいよね？
entries.en: It's okay if we\njust abandon\nyou then, right?

entries.jp: なんだと　沖田
entries.en: What was\nthat, Okita!?

entries.jp: だって罠じゃないと\n思う方がおかしいよね～\nこれ
entries.en:
I mean, you'd
have to be crazy
not to think this
is a trap~

entries.jp: おかしくねえよ
entries.en: I'm not crazy!

entries.jp: シンディはずっと\nモジャモジャの先生に\n会いたがってたんだ！
entries.en:
Shindy's been
wantin' to see the
Shaggy Sensei
this whole time!

entries.jp: 会いに行きたい\n気持ちはよくわかる
entries.en: I get how bad\nhe wants to\ngo see him.

entries.jp: 龍馬\nわかってくれるか！
entries.en: Ryoma, you\nunderstand!

entries.jp: だが『松陰先生』だ！\n呼び方には気をつけろ
entries.en:
But it's
'Shoin-sensei'!
Watch how you
address him!

entries.jp: 龍馬くん　こんなときに\n晋作の味方をしないで
entries.en:
Ryoma-kun,
please don't take
Shinsaku's side at
a time like this.

entries.jp: けど　わしも\nモジャモジャ――\nじゃなかった
entries.en: But I wanna hear\nthe Shaggy-- I\nmean...

entries.jp: センセーの先生の雷舞を\n聴いてみたいぜよ！
entries.en: ...I wanna hear\nSensei's sensei's\nlive, I tell ya!

entries.jp: こんな時に限って\n意気投合するんだから
entries.en: Of all times for\nyou two to see\neye to eye...

entries.jp: 桂さん　みんな\n頼む
entries.en: Katsura-san,\neveryone... please.

entries.jp: 突然　高杉が頭を下げた
entries.en: Suddenly,\nTakasugi\nbowed his head.

entries.jp: し　晋作
entries.en: Sh-Shinsaku...

entries.jp: 確かに罠かもしれない\n勝手な行動だってことも\nわかってる
entries.en:
Sure, it might
be a trap. And
I know I'm
being selfish.

entries.jp: それでも
entries.en: But even so...

entries.jp: どうしても松陰先生の\n雷舞に行きたいんだ！
entries.en: I want to go to\nShoin-sensei's live\nno matter what!

entries.jp: この目で確かめなくちゃ\n気がすまねえ
entries.en:
I won't be
satisfied until
I see it with
my own eyes.

entries.jp: 雷舞に行くことを\n許してくれ！
entries.en: Please let me\ngo to the live!

entries.jp: ちょっと\nそんなことするの\nやめてください
entries.en: Wait, please\ndon't do that.

entries.jp: センセー\nわしからも頼むぜよ
entries.en: Sensei, I'm askin'\nya too, pal.

entries.jp: 頼む！　行かせてくれ！
entries.en: Please, Sensei!\nLet us go!

entries.jp: えええ？
entries.en: Whaaat?

entries.jp: はああ……\nわかりましたよ
entries.en: Haaah... All\nright, fine.

entries.jp: 罠であることを前提に\n確認にいきましょう
entries.en:
Let's go check
it out, on the
assumption
that it's a trap.

entries.jp: 桂さんっ！
entries.en: Katsura-san!

entries.jp: 晋作が人に頭を下げる\nなんて　よほどのことです\nていうか初めて見ました
entries.en:
For Shinsaku to
bow his head to
someone, it
must be serious.
Actually, this is
the first time
I've ever seen it.

entries.jp: ただし　条件をつけます\nいいですね？
entries.en: However, I\nhave conditions.\nUnderstood?

entries.jp: お　おう！\nどんな条件でもいい！
entries.en: S-sure! Any\nconditions\nyou want!

entries.jp: どんなことが起きても\nいいように団体行動！\n気を抜かないこと
entries.en:
We move as a
group so we're
ready for
anything! And
no letting your
guard down.

entries.jp: 単独行動は厳禁です\nいいですね？
entries.en: Going off alone is\nstrictly forbidden.\nUnderstood?

entries.jp: ああ！　必ず守る！
entries.en: Yeah! I swear\nI'll stick to it!

entries.jp: 珍しいもの見れたし\n僕も行ってみてもいいかな
entries.en:
I got to see
something rare,
so maybe I'll
tag along too.

entries.jp: 雷舞に気をとられて\n油断するな　総司
entries.en:
Don't get
distracted by the
live and let your
guard down, Soji.

entries.jp: やったーっ！\nモジャモジャの先生の\n歌が聴けるぜよーーっ！
entries.en:
Yahooo! We get
to hear the
Shaggy Sensei
sing, I tell yaaa!

entries.jp: うっひょー！\nこんなに賑わってるとは\n凄いなあ！
entries.en: Woo-hoo! Would\nya look at this\ncrowd! Amazing!

entries.jp: さすが松陰先生の雷舞だ\n新選組に引けを取らないぜ
entries.en:
That's
Shoin-sensei's live
for you. It's every
bit as big as the
Shinsengumi's.

entries.jp: お主らも来たか……
entries.en: So you lads\nhave come too...

entries.jp: テンちゃんも\n噂を聞きつけてきたのか！
entries.en: Ten-chan! You\nheard the\nrumor too, huh!

entries.jp: 今のショウが\nどんなものを\n歌うのか……
entries.en: What sort of song\nwill Show sing\nnow, I wonder...

entries.jp: わしは見届けなくては\nならん
entries.en: I must see it\nthrough with my\nown eyes, lad.

entries.jp: ショウ？\nモジャモジャの先生の\nことか？
entries.en: Show? You\nmean the\nShaggy Sensei?

entries.jp: ん？　松陰のショウ\n舞台名（ステージネーム）\nというヤツじゃ
entries.en: Hm? Show is\nShoin's stage\nname, as they say.

entries.jp: 昔は　皆からそう\n呼ばれておった
entries.en: Back in the\nday, everyone\ncalled him that.

entries.jp: さてさて　\nショウのロックは\n健在じゃろうか
entries.en:
Well, well. I
wonder if Show's
rock is still going
strong, eh?

entries.jp: 松陰先生の歌は\n今も昔もサイコーだ\n決まってるぜ
entries.en:
Shoin-sensei's
songs are the
best, now and
always. Obviously!

entries.jp: ならば　いいのだが\nこればかりは　実際に\n確かめねばな
entries.en:
If only that were
so. But this, my
boy, we must
confirm with our
own ears.

entries.jp: もうすぐ始まるみたいだよ
entries.en: Looks like it's\nabout to start.

entries.jp: 本当に松陰先生が\n現れるんでしょうか？
entries.en: Will Shoin-sensei\nreally appear?

entries.jp: 現れると信じてるぜ！
entries.en: I believe he will!

entries.jp: そうだといいんですが……
entries.en: I hope you're\nright...

entries.jp:
期待に満ちた高杉が
舞台に目を向けると
ギターを持った松陰が
悠然と姿を現す
entries.en:
When Takasugi,
full of hope,
turned his eyes to
the stage, Shoin
appeared, guitar
in hand, calm and
composed.

entries.jp: あっ
entries.en: Ah!

entries.jp: 松陰先生
entries.en: Shoin-sensei!

entries.jp: あれは本物の先生だ！\nオレ様が見間違えるはずが\nねえ！
entries.en:
That's the real
Sensei! There's
no way yours
truly could
mistake him!

entries.jp: だろう\n桂さん！
entries.en: Right,\nKatsura-san!?

entries.jp: あれは確かに\n松陰先生です……
entries.en: That's\nShoin-sensei,\nwithout a doubt...

entries.jp: 相変わらず\nモジャモジャしてるなぁ！
entries.en: Still as shaggy\nas ever!

entries.jp: 松陰の登場に観客からの\n歓声が上がった
entries.en: A cheer rose from\nthe crowd as\nShoin appeared.

entries.jp: その声に\n高杉の呼びかけは\n届かず消える
entries.en:
Takasugi's call
was drowned
out by it and
faded away.

entries.jp: 本当に松陰先生です
entries.en: It really is\nShoin-sensei.

entries.jp: 罠ではなかったのか
entries.en: So it wasn't\na trap?

entries.jp: そう……ですね　それなら\n私も久しぶりに松陰先生の\n音楽を聴くことができます
entries.en:
It... seems so.
In that case,
I'll get to hear
Shoin-sensei's
music for the
first time in
ages too.

entries.jp: けど　なんだろう……\nとても嫌な予感がする
entries.en: But what is this...?\nI have a terrible\nfeeling about this.

entries.jp: うっ！
entries.en: Ngh!

entries.jp: 歓声を掻き消すほどの\n大きな音が会場に響いた
entries.en:
A sound loud
enough to drown
out the cheers
rang through
the venue.

entries.jp: 皆　待たせたのう！\nわしの雷舞　最後まで\n楽しんでいってくれ
entries.en:
Sorry to keep you
all waiting! Enjoy
my live right to
the very end!

entries.jp: 早速　行ってみようか！
entries.en: Let's get\nright to it!

entries.jp: うっ！\nなんだ　これは……
entries.en: Ngh! What...\nis this...?

entries.jp: スカシくん？\n頭を抱えて大丈夫？
entries.en:
Mr. Poser?
You're clutching
your head. Are
you okay?

entries.jp: 大丈夫……じゃねえ\n頭が割れそうだ！
entries.en: I'm... not okay!\nMy head feels\nlike it's splitting!

entries.jp: 高杉は手で頭を抱えると\n痛みに耐えかねて膝を折る
entries.en:
Takasugi
clutched his head
in his hands and,
unable to bear
the pain, dropped
to his knees.

entries.jp: ちょっと！
entries.en: Hey!

entries.jp: はぁっ　はぁっ
entries.en: Hah... hah...

entries.jp: わしも……\nあのギターの音色が\n頭にがんがん響くぜよ……
entries.en:
Me too... That
guitar's
pounding away
inside my skull...

entries.jp: 気を抜くと意識が\n吹っ飛びそうだ
entries.en: If I let my guard\ndown, I'll black\nout for sure.

entries.jp: 私も眩暈がする……
entries.en: I feel dizzy too...

entries.jp: 松陰先生の歌って\nこんな感じでしたか？
entries.en:
Were
Shoin-sensei's
songs always
like this?

entries.jp: わからねえ……\nただ　この音楽を聴いて\nいるとおかしくなりそうだ
entries.en:
I don't know...
But listening to
this music feels
like it'll drive
me insane.

entries.jp: 龍馬くんはどう思う？
entries.en: What do\nyou think,\nRyoma-kun?

entries.jp: わからん
entries.en: No idea

entries.jp: これは違う！
entries.en: This ain't right!

entries.jp: これぞロック
entries.en: Now THIS is rock

entries.jp: わからん……\nわしもシンディと同じで\n頭が割れそうだ
entries.en:
No idea... Just
like Shindy, my
head feels like
it's splittin'.

entries.jp: そうですね……\n聞くまでもありません\nでした
entries.en: I see... I needn't\nhave asked.

entries.jp: これは違う！\nロックは人を楽しませる\nもんだ
entries.en:
This ain't right!
Rock's supposed
to make people
have fun!

entries.jp: この歌は心じゃなく\n頭に響いて　痛いぜよ
entries.en:
This song hits
your head, not
your heart, and
it hurts, I tell ya.

entries.jp: こんなの……\nロックとは違うぜよ……！
entries.en: This... this ain't\nrock at all...!

entries.jp: 私もそう思います……
entries.en: I think so too...

entries.jp: この痺れる感じが\nロックということなのか？
entries.en: Is this tinglin'\nfeeling what\nrock is?

entries.jp: 頭にがんがん響くぜよ\nでも　わしはあんまり\n好きじゃない……
entries.en:
It's poundin'
away in my
head... But I don't
much like it...

entries.jp: モジャモジャの先生は\nどうしてこんな歌を\n歌うんじゃ……？
entries.en: Why's the Shaggy\nSensei singin' a\nsong like this...?

entries.jp: 他の人は平気みたいだね\nでも……
entries.en: Everyone else\nseems fine,\nthough...

entries.jp: 僕も少し頭が痛いな……\n土方さんは？
entries.en:
My head hurts
a little too...
How about you,
Hijikata-san?

entries.jp: 集中していれば\nこの程度は問題ない\nだが　この歌は……
entries.en:
If I focus, this
much is no
problem. But
this song...

entries.jp: おかしいですよね……これ\nやっぱり\n罠だったみたいだね
entries.en:
Something's
off about this,
isn't it... Looks
like it was a
trap after all.

entries.jp: おお　おお　ショウよ……\n何ということだ
entries.en: Oh, oh, Show...\nWhat has\nbecome of you?

entries.jp: この歌は　こんなものは\nお前の歌ではなかろう
entries.en:
This song... a
thing like this
is no song of
yours, is it?

entries.jp: やっぱり　あの松陰先生は\nニセモノだったってことか
entries.en:
So that
Shoin-sensei
really was a
fake after all?

entries.jp: あれはニセモノなどでは\nないぞ　あれはショウ\nまさしく吉田松陰じゃ
entries.en:
That's no fake,
lad. That is
Show. Shoin
Yoshida himself.

entries.jp: じゃあ　何だってこんな\n歌を歌うんだ
entries.en: Then why the\nhell is he singing\na song like this?

entries.jp:
舞台上の松陰を
見上げたとき
音圧が一気に
高杉の脳を揺さぶった
entries.en:
As Takasugi
looked up at
Shoin on the
stage, a wall of
sound shook his
brain all at once.

entries.jp: ぐぅぅっ\nま　負けるかっ！
entries.en: Grrrngh... I-I\nwon't lose!

entries.jp: こんな歌は……\n松陰先生の歌じゃねぇっ\nニセモノだ！
entries.en:
A song like this...
isn't
Shoin-sensei's
song! He's a fake!

entries.jp: 晋作……
entries.en: Shinsaku...

entries.jp: オレ様がニセモノだと\n暴いてやるぜっ！
entries.en: Yours truly is\ngonna expose\nthis fake!

entries.jp:
高杉は崩れ落ちそうな体を
怒りで動かす
立ち上がり　舞台に向かって
駆けだした
entries.en:
Takasugi drove
his crumbling
body on with
rage, stood up,
and dashed
toward the stage.

entries.jp: 松陰先生
entries.en: Shoin-sensei!

entries.jp: 晋作
entries.en: Shinsaku!

entries.jp: わわっ\n何してんのっ？
entries.en: Whoa! What\nare you doing!?

entries.jp: 警護の武士をかいくぐり\n高杉は舞台中央に立つ\n吉田松陰と対峙した
entries.en:
Slipping past the
guards, Takasugi
confronted Shoin
Yoshida at the
center of the
stage.

entries.jp: ぬっ？
entries.en: Hm?

entries.jp: お前は松陰先生じゃねえ！\n正体を現せニセモノ！
entries.en:
You're not
Shoin-sensei!
Show your true
face, you fake!

entries.jp: ……晋作か\n久しぶりだな
entries.en: ...Shinsaku, is\nit? It's been a\nlong time.

entries.jp: 気安くオレ様の名前を\n呼ぶんじゃねえ！\nこのニセモノ野郎が
entries.en:
Don't you dare
say my name
like you know
me, you fraud!

entries.jp: 誰がニセモノだと？\nこのわしがわからぬのか\n晋作
entries.en:
Who are you
calling a
fake? Don't
you recognize
me, Shinsaku?

entries.jp: ……ううっ
entries.en: ...Ngh.

entries.jp: この顔　この髪　この声\n間違いねえ……\n松陰先生だ！
entries.en:
This face, this
hair, this voice...
There's no
mistaking it...
It's Shoin-sensei!

entries.jp: 当たり前じゃ\nわしが松陰でなくて\n誰がそうなんだ？
entries.en: Of course. If\nI'm not Shoin,\nthen who is?

entries.jp: じゃあ……じゃあ\n本物……なんですね
entries.en: Then... then\nyou're... the\nreal one?

entries.jp: もちろんじゃ！\n吉田松陰とは\nわしのことじゃあああ！
entries.en: Of course I\nam! I am Shoin\nYoshidaaaaa!

entries.jp: ぐはぁっ！
entries.en: Gwaaah!

entries.jp: 目の前でかき鳴らされる\nギターの演奏に\n高杉はたまらず頭を抱えた
entries.en:
With the guitar
raging right in
front of him,
Takasugi
couldn't help but
clutch his head.

entries.jp: 本物なのに　なんで……
entries.en: He's the real\none, so why...

entries.jp: なんでこんなに\n以前と音楽が違うんだ
entries.en: Why is his music\nso different\nfrom before?

entries.jp: オレ様の目の前にいるのは\n間違いなく松陰先生だが
entries.en:
The man in front
of yours truly is
Shoin-sensei, no
doubt about it...

entries.jp: この音楽は……\n松陰先生の歌じゃねえ
entries.en:
But this
music... It ain't
Shoin-sensei's
song.

entries.jp: オレ様の体には\n松陰先生の音楽が\n至る所に染みてるんだ
entries.en:
Shoin-sensei's
music has
soaked into
every last corner
of my body!

entries.jp: オレ様の血は\n松陰先生から教わった\n志士の血！
entries.en:
The blood in
my veins is a
rebel's blood,
taught to me by
Shoin-sensei!

entries.jp: だから　わかる……
entries.en: That's how\nI know...

entries.jp: てめえは\n松陰先生であって\n松陰先生じゃねええええ！
entries.en:
You're
Shoin-sensei...
and you're NOT
Shoin-senseiiiii!

entries.jp: ひよっこが\nわかったようなことを\nほざくではないか
entries.en:
You mere
fledgling!
Spouting off
as though you
understand.

entries.jp: 聴けい！\nわしのロックを
entries.en: Hear me!\nHear my rock!

entries.jp: うわぁぁぁぁぁっ
entries.en: Waaaaaaargh!

entries.jp: 松陰の叫びと演奏に\n高杉ははじき飛ばされ\n舞台から落下した
entries.en:
Thrown back by
Shoin's cry and
playing, Takasugi
tumbled off the
stage.

entries.jp: シンディ！
entries.en: Shindy!

entries.jp: スカシくん！
entries.en: Mr. Poser!

entries.jp: 晋作っ！\n大丈夫ですか
entries.en: Shinsaku! Are\nyou all right?

entries.jp: 龍馬たちが\n高杉を受け止める
entries.en: Ryoma and the\nothers caught\nTakasugi.

entries.jp: 放せ！
entries.en: Let go!

entries.jp: オレ様は……\n松陰先生に……！
entries.en: Yours truly...\nhas to reach\nShoin-sensei...!

entries.jp: 無理はするな\n高杉
entries.en: Don't push\nyourself,\nTakasugi.

entries.jp:
それでも立ち上がり
舞台に戻ろうとする
高杉に　松陰の歌が
襲いかかる
entries.en:
Even so, Takasugi
got up and tried
to return to the
stage, and Shoin's
song came
crashing down on
him.

entries.jp: うああぁぁぁっ！
entries.en: Uwaaaaagh!

entries.jp: 高杉は松陰の歌声に\nまたも崩れ落ちた
entries.en:
Under Shoin's
singing, Takasugi
collapsed once
again.

entries.jp: ああ……あああっ
entries.en: Ahh... aaagh...

entries.jp: 確かに強力な演奏だが\nどうして高杉だけが\nこれほど影響されるんだ？
entries.en:
It's powerful
playing, I'll grant.
But why is
Takasugi the only
one hit this hard?

entries.jp: そうか　晋作は誰よりも\n先生の音楽を聴き込んで\nいます
entries.en:
Of course...
Shinsaku has
listened to
Sensei's music
more deeply
than anyone.

entries.jp: 身体全体が　先生の演奏に\n自然に反応してしまうんです\nでも　あの歌は……
entries.en:
His whole body
reacts to
Sensei's playing
on its own. But
that song...

entries.jp: では　やはりあれは\n本物の吉田松陰なのか
entries.en: Then that really\nis Shoin Yoshida\nhimself?

entries.jp: ぐがあっ……
entries.en: Gaaah...

entries.jp: 高杉　しっかりしろ！
entries.en: Takasugi, pull\nyourself together!

entries.jp: シンディ……
entries.en: Shindy...

entries.jp: 高杉　大丈夫か？
entries.en: Takasugi, are\nyou all right, lad?

entries.jp: 天狗の……ジジイ……
entries.en: You... Tengu...\ngeezer...

entries.jp: 仲間のみんなに支えられ\n高杉は目を開けた
entries.en:
Held up by all
his comrades,
Takasugi
opened his eyes.

entries.jp:
天狗に体を支えられると
なぜか全身の痛みが
和らいでいくのが
不思議だった
entries.en:
Strangely, the
moment the
Tengu took
hold of him, the
pain all through
his body began
to ease.

entries.jp: はぁ　はぁ……\nあんな歌は……違う……\n松陰先生の歌じゃねえ
entries.en:
*Pant, pant*...
That song is...
wrong... It ain't
Shoin-sensei's
song.

entries.jp: けど……うっ！
entries.en: But... ngh!

entries.jp: シンディしっかりするぜよ\n尊敬する先生に……\nようやく会えたんだ……
entries.en:
Hang in there,
Shindy, ya hear?
You finally got to
meet the teacher
you look up to...

entries.jp: わかっている……
entries.en: I know...

entries.jp: うあああっ
entries.en: Uaaaagh!

entries.jp: スカシくん　\nしっかりしなよ！
entries.en: Come on, Mr.\nPoser, pull it\ntogether!

entries.jp: あーもう\n僕もますます気持ち悪く\nなってきちゃった
entries.en:
Ugh, come on...
Now I'm
starting to feel
even sicker too.

entries.jp: このままではまずい\nひとまずここから出るぞ
entries.en: This is bad.\nWe're getting out\nof here for now.

entries.jp: そうですね
entries.en: Agreed.

entries.jp: 土方達が高杉達の体を\n起こして運ぼうとすると\n武士が立ちはだかった
entries.en:
As Hijikata and
the others lifted
Takasugi and the
rest to carry them
out, samurai
blocked their way.

entries.jp: そこをどけ
entries.en: Out of the way.

entries.jp: 武士は\n土方の言葉を無視して\nその場に立ち続ける
entries.en:
The samurai
ignored Hijikata's
words and stayed
rooted to the
spot.

entries.jp: 音量が大きくて\n聞こえていないのかな？
entries.en:
Maybe it's too
loud in here
and they
can't hear us?

entries.jp: どけよ！\n会場から出せ
entries.en: Move it! Let us\nout of here!

entries.jp: 声を張り上げるが\n武士は道を空けなかった
entries.en:
He raised his
voice, but the
samurai didn't
clear the way.

entries.jp: おかしい……\nこれじゃまるで……
entries.en: Something's off...\nThis is just like...

entries.jp:
沖田は武士の目が虚ろな
ことに気が付いた
武士たちは彼らを会場から
出さないよう
ただ立っているだけ
entries.en:
Okita noticed
that the samurai's
eyes were empty.
They were simply
standing there to
keep everyone
from leaving the
hall.

entries.jp: まずい……僕達\n捕まったかもしれない
entries.en: Uh-oh... We might\nbe trapped.

entries.jp: こいつら\n泰平化されてやがる
entries.en: These guys have\nbeen pacified.

entries.jp: そういう……ことか……
entries.en: So... that's\nhow it is...

entries.jp: くうう……\n松陰先生……！
entries.en: Nngh...\nShoin-sensei...!

entries.jp: ようやくわかった\nこれは天歌だ
entries.en: Now I finally\nget it. This is\nHeaven's Song.

entries.jp: ええ\n鳳舞合奏に少し似てる
entries.en: Yes. It's a little\nlike Phoenix\nRising.

entries.jp: でも　僕たちだけが\n苦しんでる\nみたいですけど……
entries.en: But it seems\nonly we are\nsuffering...

entries.jp: 観客は全員　すでに\n泰平化されているんだ
entries.en:
The whole
audience has
already been
pacified.

entries.jp: ああ　なるほど\n土方さんと僕が\nまだマシなのは
entries.en:
Ah, I see. So that's
why Hijikata-san
and I are still
holding up better.

entries.jp: 俺達が新選組だからだ\n天歌には耐性がある
entries.en:
Because we're
Shinsengumi.
We have a
tolerance for
Heaven's Song.

entries.jp: 今の松陰は\n泰平化されている
entries.en: Shoin, as he\nis now, has\nbeen pacified.

entries.jp: ……そうか\nそういうことなのか\nあれは……あの歌は
entries.en: ...I see. So that's\nhow it is. That...\nthat song is...

entries.jp: 高杉　いや晋作よ\nあのショウの姿が\n見えるか？
entries.en:
Takasugi... no,
Shinsaku. Can
you see Show up
there, my boy?

entries.jp: じいさん……？
entries.en: Old man...?

entries.jp: 止めてやってはくれぬか\nあの歌は　ショウが望んで\n歌っているのではない
entries.en:
Won't you stop
him for me? Show
isn't singing that
song because he
wishes to.

entries.jp: ショウを止められるのは\n弟子であるお前達だけじゃ
entries.en: Only you, his\ndisciples, can\nstop Show.

entries.jp: 本当のショウの音楽を\n受け継いだ　お前にしか\nできんことなのじゃ
entries.en:
It's something
only you can do,
lad, you who
inherited Show's
true music.

entries.jp: 高杉が　舞台の上の\n松陰を仰ぎ見る
entries.en: Takasugi looked\nup at Shoin on\nthe stage.

entries.jp: 高杉　しっかり見ろ\nあれは本当にお前達の\n尊敬する師匠か！
entries.en:
Takasugi, look
closely! Is that
really the master
you all respect!?

entries.jp: 違う……\nあれは松陰先生であって\n松陰先生にあらず！
entries.en:
No... That's
Shoin-sensei,
and yet it's not
Shoin-sensei!

entries.jp: こんな歌に影響されて\nお前らの師匠が喜ぶのか！
entries.en:
Would your
master be
happy to see
you broken by a
song like this!?

entries.jp: その通りだぜ\n松陰先生が一番\n悲しんでるはず！
entries.en:
Damn right!
Shoin-sensei's
gotta be the
one hurting
most of all!

entries.jp: 晋作……歌を……\n魂の叫びを……\n松陰先生に届けよう……
entries.en:
Shinsaku... let's
send our song...
the cry of our
souls... to
Shoin-sensei...

entries.jp: 私達の歌で松陰先生を\n助けるんだ
entries.en: We'll save\nShoin-sensei\nwith our song.

entries.jp: ああ
entries.en: Yeah.

entries.jp: シンディ……\n暴れてやれ……！
entries.en: Shindy... go raise\nsome hell...!

entries.jp: そうだな……\nオレ様の全てを\n松陰先生にぶつけてやる
entries.en:
Right... Yours
truly is gonna
hit Shoin-sensei
with everything
he's got.

entries.jp: こんな最悪な歌\n松陰先生じゃねえ
entries.en: A song this rotten\nain't Shoin-sensei.

entries.jp: オレ様のロックで先生の\n魂を揺さぶり起こして\n目を覚まさせてやるぜ
entries.en:
I'll shake Sensei's
soul awake with
my rock and
make him open
his eyes!

entries.jp: 行くぜ　松陰先生！
entries.en: Here I come,\nShoin-sensei!

entries.jp: 高杉は力を振り絞って\n武士達を薙ぎ払うと\n再び舞台に上がった
entries.en:
Takasugi
summoned all his
strength, swept
the samurai
aside, and
climbed onto the
stage once more.

entries.jp: また　来たのか\n何度来ても同じじゃぞ
entries.en:
Back again, are
you? It makes
no difference
how many times
you come, boy.

entries.jp: 松陰先生！\n待ってて下さい！\nオレが救ってみせる
entries.en: Shoin-sensei! Just\nhold on! I'll save\nyou, I swear it!

entries.jp: ふははは\n口ばかりだな　晋作\n師に勝てると思うのか
entries.en:
Ha ha ha! All
talk, Shinsaku.
You think you
can beat your
own master?

entries.jp: 勝てるさ！\nなぜなら　それを
entries.en: Course I can!\nBecause...

entries.jp: 貴方が一番\n望んでいるからだっ！
entries.en: ...that's what\nyou want more\nthan anything!

entries.jp: ふざけるなっ　晋作！
entries.en: Quit your\nnonsense,\nShinsaku!

entries.jp: うおおおおおお
entries.en: Raaaaaaaagh!

entries.jp: 来てる　来てるぜ……\n松陰先生に教わった魂が\nオレ様の中で疼いてやがる
entries.en:
It's coming, it's
coming... The
soul Shoin-sensei
taught me is
stirring inside
yours truly!

entries.jp: これがロックの魂だ\n貴方が遺してくれた魂は\nオレ様に宿っているんだ
entries.en:
This is the soul
of rock! The soul
you left behind
lives in me!

entries.jp: オレ様が勝ってみせるぜ！\nそれが貴方への恩返しだ
entries.en:
The great
Takasugi is gonna
win! That's how
I'll repay you!

entries.jp: 来たぜ来たぜ……\nオレ様の中でロックが\n雷光してるぜ
entries.en:
Here it comes,
here it comes...
The rock inside
me is throwing
sparks!

entries.jp: 来い　来い　来い\nクールに行くぜ
entries.en: Come on, come\non, come on!\nLet's keep it cool!

entries.jp: ブラック　オア　ホワイト\n黒か？　それとも白か？\n伸るか反るかだ
entries.en:
Black or
white! Black?
Or is it white?
All or nothing!

entries.jp: 松陰先生\n最後まで付き合って\nもらうぜええええ
entries.en:
Shoin-sensei,
you're sticking
with me till the
very eeeeend!
